System-Level Cache Load and Save

Source: R/49-CacheSysCall.R
CacheSysCall.Rd

High-level wrapper for loading and saving cached screening results. Combines cache path resolution (via CacheSetHere()), configuration validation (via CheckCache()), and data I/O (via LoadCache() or WriteCache()) into a single call.

Usage

CacheSysCall(
  mode = c("load", "save"),
  path = NULL,
  cache,
  verbose = TRUE,
  timestamp = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

mode

character. Either "load" or "save".

path

character or NULL. Path passed to CacheSetHere(). In save mode a NULL value falls back to cache@cache_path. In load mode it is mandatory: a NULL value aborts, no cache is looked up implicitly. Default: NULL.

cache

A ScreenMethodConfig or ScreenMethodCache S7 object. For save mode, a ScreenMethodCache is required (contains the data to write). For load mode, either class is accepted.

verbose

logical. Whether to print progress messages. Default: TRUE.

timestamp

character or NULL. Optional timestamp string for the new cache directory in save mode. Passed to CacheSetHere().

...

Additional arguments passed to WriteCache() in save mode (e.g., format, max_rows, max_cols).

Value

In "load" mode, a named list of loaded cache data objects. In "save" mode, the cache data invisibly.

Details

CacheSysCall is the primary entry point for cache operations in the SigBridgeR pipeline. It dispatches to either CacheSysCall.load() or CacheSysCall.save() based on the mode argument.

Load mode

In "load" mode, the function:

  1. Resolves the cache path via CacheSetHere().

  2. Validates cache consistency via CheckCache().

  3. Loads each cached data object via LoadCache() and returns them as a named list.

Save mode

In "save" mode, the function:

  1. Resolves and creates the cache directory via CacheSetHere().

  2. Writes the cache data and metadata via WriteCache().

  3. Returns the cache data invisibly.

See also

Other cache_config: CacheSetHere(), CheckCache(), ChooseCache(), LoadCache(), WriteCache(), WriteCacheMeta()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Load cached results
cache <- ScreenMethodCache(
  cache_path = "Scissor_res/",
  cache_config_path = "Scissor_res/cache_config.json",
  cache_data = list(),
  screen_method_config = ScreenMethodConfig(
    screen_method = "Scissor",
    param = list(alpha = 0.05)
  )
)
result <- CacheSysCall(
  "load",
  path = "Scissor_res/survival_2025_01_01",
  cache = cache
)

# Save results to cache
cache <- ScreenMethodCache(
  cache_path = "Scissor_res/",
  cache_config_path = "Scissor_res/cache_config.json",
  cache_data = list(result = my_matrix),
  screen_method_config = ScreenMethodConfig(
    screen_method = "Scissor",
    param = list(alpha = 0.05)
  )
)
CacheSysCall("save", cache = cache)
} # }
